learning: If s-bend line-loss falls to 1.0 or below with the oval holding, keep this kp and kd. If the oval oscillates above about 0.35 with low max_error, revert kp to 2.5 and keep kd. If s-bend line-loss stays at 1.3 or more, the controller gain is not the lever, and the next test should be line_loss mode.
notes: Geometry held at iteration 7 best values; controller changed only in kp (2.5 to 3.0) and kd (0.3 to 0.45) to test whether a sharper bend response reduces s-bend line-loss.
rationale: Iteration 7 (mass 0.5 kg, wheel_track 0.09 m, y 0.07 m, span ±0.03 m, footprint 0.012 m) is the best-known design at 400.0. The oval finishes 17/20 with steering_oscillation 0.30 and max_error 0.039 m, so the jitter guard is not triggered. The sharp tracks remain the gap: s-bend finishes 2/20 with line-loss 1.4 and max_error 0.062 m, and slalom is 0/20 with line-loss 1.95. Geometry levers (span, footprint, y, wheel_track, mass) have been tested or are at their floor, so this iteration changes only the controller, as the Builder's intent requests. Geometry is held exactly at the iteration 7 values. The controller change is a moderate increase in proportional and derivative gain to sharpen the response on bends: kp 2.5 to 3.0 and kd 0.3 to 0.45. Weights stay [-2,-1,0,1,2] and base_speed stays at 1.2, because the s-bend mean finish time of 2.45 s leaves little margin against the 3 s limit, so lowering speed is not an option. ki stays at 0 because there is no windup evidence. line_loss stays last_direction. Expected result, not yet measured: s-bend line-loss falls toward 1.0 to 1.2 per run with the oval holding at 16/20 or better. Guard: if oval steering_oscillation exceeds about 0.35 with low max_error, the higher kd or kp is causing jitter and kp should return to 2.5. Measurements add control_effort and controller_errors to read the controller response.
